Antivirus: Maldet (Linux Malware Detect) replaces AI-Bolit (the project is closed) as the third engine next to the built-in scan and ClamAV. The Install Maldet button downloads a release from GitHub itself and turns off its file monitoring and cron jobs; the scan runs one after another with the other antiviruses, and findings are cleaned up and quarantined as usual.

Maldet signatures are updated automatically every 4 hours and with the Update signatures button in the Maldet block; the Update Maldet button installs a new release of the program. Linux only (the built-in scan and ClamAV are available on FreeBSD).
The AI-Bolit scanner downloaded earlier is removed during the update.
